# HAPI v0.29.0.3 (maintained build)

Upstream-first rebuild from `tiann/hapi` `upstream/main` at `980a921ba15665c54998a6ddb658103d467ff4cb`, with the audited self-maintained overlay and four newly selected exact-head pull requests.

## Compared with the previous maintained release

Compared with `v0.29.0.2`, this release:

- Keeps the official upstream base unchanged; `upstream/main` still matches the upstream `v0.29.0` source head used by the previous maintained release.
- Carries `#1726` to align file-preview content around scrollbars.
- Carries `#1727` so archived or inactive session workspaces remain readable through the long-lived Runner while retaining maintained RPC cancellation and runner-upgrade capabilities.
- Carries `#1728` so an expanded composer collapses as soon as a send is submitted, while retained settlement handling still protects delayed failure recovery and newer edits.
- Carries `#1729` so plain Enter inserts a newline in the expanded composer and Ctrl/Command+Enter sends.
- Retains every previously shipped audited carry and all operator drop decisions without replaying deferred PRs.

## Compared with the official release

Compared with official `v0.29.0`, this build contains the maintained desktop, fleet, import, jobs, model-error, scratchlist, schema V29, protocol v2, and audited open-PR behavior already shipped in `v0.29.0.2`, plus `#1726`, `#1727`, `#1728`, and `#1729`.

Open-PR audit: 141 open PRs reviewed — 46 carry, 91 defer, 4 drop. The nine PRs opened since `v0.29.0.2` were reviewed at their exact heads. `#1730`, `#1733`, `#1738`, `#1741`, and `#1742` are deferred for unresolved review findings, cross-platform risk, missing route-level coverage, or unrelated scope. `#1680`, `#1597`/`#1093`, and `#1091` remain dropped; `#1320` remains permanently excluded if reopened.

## Distribution

This is a standalone four-part maintained release; it is not published to npm. Its implicit standalone fleet-upgrade channel is therefore disabled, while explicit overrides remain authoritative. Optional platform packages remain pinned to official `0.29.0`.

Expected artifacts:

- CLI archives for Linux, macOS, and Windows
- Signed macOS CLI archives
- Windows and macOS desktop bundles
- `checksums.txt`
